description.value: Whether you're frequently plugging sponsors, talking to chat, or showing off merch, you're always performing for the cameras. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Earn Income] after Livestreaming for 24 hours in exploration mode. These hours don't need to be consecutive, but each show must be at least 1 hour long to count toward the total number of hours required to roll to determine your earnings. If you're an expert in Performance, you only need 12 hours to receive earnings. If you're a master in Performance, you only need 8 hours. If you're legendary in Performance, you only need 1 hour. You can receive earnings only once per day.
